targetRule: The final observed KRX price date in each target calendar month; close-to-close percent change from the 2026-06-30 close
trainingRule: For each horizon, use prior month-end origins only when that horizon's entire target month ended no later than 2026-06-30; one row per company and origin month
source: Locally archived official KRX KOSPI daily raw-price responses
priceBasis: Unadjusted closing price in KRW; no dividends, fees or slippage
metrics: direction accuracy excluding zero predictions and actuals
availabilityAssumption: A prior KRX close is treated as available by 08:30 KST on the next business day under the customary approximately 08:00 update; exact historical publication and response versions are unavailable
selectionDisclosure: This historical interval was selected in October 2026 after some Q3 prices and related backtests had been inspected; it is a retrospective demonstration, not an untouched prospective holdout
